use_cases: Landing page call-to-action buttons that draw user attention through magnetic particle animations
Interactive product showcase buttons with hover attraction effects
Engagement-focused CTAs for marketing campaigns and conversion pages
Premium SaaS dashboard buttons with playful micro-interactions
ai_summary: An interactive button component featuring magnetic particle effects that animate toward the button center on hover and click interactions. Built with motion/react animations and spring physics for smooth particle attraction. Includes customizable particle count and attraction radius with violet-themed styling and dark mode support.
